import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.pipeline import FeatureUnion
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# Ensure output directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets from input directory
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Define class labels
target_classes = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
label_mapping = {cls: i for i, cls in enumerate(target_classes)}

# Encode training labels
train_labels = train_df["author"].map(label_mapping)

# Extract features and labels
X_train_raw = train_df["text"]
y_train = train_labels.values

X_test_raw = test_df["text"]
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Text Preprocessing: lowercase version for word features
preprocess_lower = lambda x: str(x).lower().strip()
X_train_proc_lower = X_train_raw.apply(preprocess_lower)
X_test_proc_lower = X_test_raw.apply(preprocess_lower)

# Keep original casing for case-sensitive features
X_train_proc_orig = X_train_raw.astype(str).str.strip()
X_test_proc_orig = X_test_raw.astype(str).strip()

# --- VALIDATION STEP (No Resubstitution) ---
# Split training data into training_fold and validation_fold
X_train_fold, X_val_fold, y_train_fold, y_val_fold = train_test_split(
    X_train_proc_lower, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Word-level features
word_vectorizer_lower = TfidfVectorizer(
    token_pattern=r"(?u)\b\w+\b", max_features=10000, min_df=2, max_df=0.98
)

# Case-sensitive word features
word_vectorizer_orig = TfidfVectorizer(
    token_pattern=r"(?u)\b\w+\b", max_features=5000, min_df=2, max_df=0.98
)

# Character unigrams
char_uni_vectorizer_lower = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(1, 1), max_features=10000, min_df=2
)

# Character bigrams
char_bigram_vectorizer_lower = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(2, 2), max_features=10000, min_df=2
)

# Character trigrams
char_trigram_vectorizer_lower = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(3, 3), max_features=10000, min_df=1
)

# Character quad-grams
char_quad_vectorizer_lower = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(4, 4), max_features=10000, min_df=1
)

# Case-sensitive character n-grams including full range
char_ngrams_case = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(1, 4), max_features=10000, min_df=1
)

# Punctuation pattern features
punct_vectorizer_lower = TfidfVectorizer(
    token_pattern=r"[^\w\s]", strip_accents=None, max_features=5000, min_df=1
)

# Word-level features for punctuation context
word_and_punct_vectorizer_lower = TfidfVectorizer(
    token_pattern=r"(?u)[\w]+|[^\w\s]", max_features=15000, min_df=1
)

feature_union = FeatureUnion(
    [
        ("word_features_lower", word_vectorizer_lower),
        ("word_features_orig", word_vectorizer_orig),
        ("char_uni_features_lower", char_uni_vectorizer_lower),
        ("char_bigram_features_lower", char_bigram_vectorizer_lower),
        ("char_trigram_features_lower", char_trigram_vectorizer_lower),
        ("char_quad_features_lower", char_quad_vectorizer_lower),
        ("case_ngram_features", char_ngrams_case),
        ("punct_features", punct_vectorizer_lower),
        ("word_punct_features", word_and_punct_vectorizer_lower),
    ]
)

X_train_vectors = feature_union.fit_transform(X_train_fold)
X_val_vectors = feature_union.transform(X_val_fold)

# Train model on training_fold only with BALANCED CLASS WEIGHTS
clf_temp = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=2000,
    solver="lbfgs",
    random_state=42,
    C=1.0,
    n_jobs=-1,
    class_weight="balanced",
)
clf_temp.fit(X_train_vectors, y_train_fold)

# Evaluate metric on hold-out fold
val_proba = clf_temp.predict_proba(X_val_vectors)
val_log_loss = log_loss(y_val_fold, val_proba, labels=clf_temp.classes_)
print(f"Hold-out Validation Log Loss: {val_log_loss:.4f}")

# --- FINAL SUBMISSION TRAINING ---
# Retrain on full training data for best possible submission performance
X_train_full_vectors = feature_union.fit_transform(X_train_proc_lower)
X_test_vectors = feature_union.transform(X_test_proc_lower)

clf_final = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=2000,
    solver="lbfgs",
    random_state=42,
    C=1.0,
    n_jobs=-1,
    class_weight="balanced",
)
clf_final.fit(X_train_full_vectors, y_train)

# Generate probabilities for test set
test_proba = clf_final.predict_proba(X_test_vectors)

# Align columns for submission based on label mapping
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(test_proba, columns=target_classes)
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_ids)
submission_df = submission_df.reindex(columns=["id", "EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
